subject.title: Persistent "database is locked" SQLite errors spamming logs on every session/cron start

question: After controlled reproduction, should the project adopt one shared SQLite contention policy or keep the Memory Core migration and auth-profile bookkeeping repairs owner-specific?
rationale: The issue spans two independently described persistence operations, and the requested global WAL, timeout, and retry changes would affect broader storage behavior than the evidence currently proves.

options.title: Repair each owner after reproduction
options.body: Reproduce both writes and give each subsystem a bounded, explicitly tested recovery path.

options.title: Adopt a shared policy
options.body: Standardize connection or retry behavior only if both paths demonstrably share a safe transaction and lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Repair each owner after reproduction
recommendation.body: Reproduce both writes and give each subsystem a bounded, explicitly tested recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter currently has the most concrete environment and log evidence needed to validate the proposed reproduction; code ownership remains unestablished.
